topic.angle: A metal that melts in your hand

card.title: The metal that melts in your hand

body.claim: Gallium will melt in a person's hands.
body.why: Its melting point is 29.7646 °C, below normal human body temperature of 37 °C. It is one of only four metal elements that is liquid at, or near, normal room temperature.

probes.question: True or false: gallium will melt in a person's hands at normal human body temperature.
